parent_information_gap.source_evidence: The frozen FXCM source stores absolute 32-bit match positions but resolves every candidate byte through bufr(position)=buffer[position & 0x00ffffff].
parent_information_gap.consequence: After 16,777,216 transformed bytes, an old absolute position addresses the newest ring occupant of the same slot rather than its original decoded byte.
parent_information_gap.nonclaim: This source audit proves absence of exact far addressing, not opportunity volume or compression gain.

exact_transition.coordinate: zero-based post-WRT transformed byte position i
exact_transition.initial_hash: For i=16, H=0; for j=0..15 in increasing order set H=H*0x9e3779b185ebca87+history[j] modulo 2^64.
exact_transition.rolling_hash: After truth x_i is scored and before position i+1, set H=H*0x9e3779b185ebca87-history[i-16]*0x6fe6ef9fbd3b9581+x_i modulo 2^64.
exact_transition.record_layout: two uint32 values: tag then continuation_plus_one; in-memory native endianness is non-semantic
exact_transition.verification_tag: uint32(H >> 32); hash bits 24..31 are deliberately unused
exact_transition.decode_position: c=continuation_plus_one-1; valid stored c is at least 16 and strictly below i
exact_transition.exact_verification: Require history[c-16+j] == history[i-16+j] for every j=0..15 in source order; otherwise D is inactive.
exact_transition.alias_control: Before x_i is inserted, S predicts ring[c & 0x00ffffff], exactly the newest already-decoded occupant of the parent's ring slot.
exact_transition.random_control: R predicts the high byte of SplitMix64(H xor (uint64(i)<<1) xor 0xd1b54a32d192ed03).
exact_transition.score_order: Construct D/S/R/N from state through i-1, score all active arms against x_i, then mutate state.
exact_transition.replacement: For every i>=16 after scoring, overwrite table[H & 0x00ffffff] with tag=uint32(H>>32), continuation_plus_one=uint32(i+1).
exact_transition.continuation_state: none; every position performs a fresh frozen-key lookup and exact verification
exact_transition.collision_rule: A tag mismatch, empty record, invalid c, or any exact-verification mismatch suppresses D and all matched controls at that position; the post-score replacement still occurs.

scanner_causal_surface.sequential_truth: The sealed transformed population supplies x_i only to the score-and-update step.
scanner_causal_surface.historical_accessor: Every nonsequential byte read passes PastByte(index,i), which aborts unless index<i; the source contains no other random input-file accessor.
scanner_causal_surface.native_history: A later codec uses an append-only exact transformed-history scratch file; file identity, address, residency, faults, and timing never enter prediction.
scanner_causal_surface.encoder_decoder_identity: Both sides perform the exact transition above from already decoded bytes without transmitted offsets, lengths, matches, or tables.

smallest_decisive_gate.chronological_transfer: In each frozen third, D_correct - max(S_correct,R_correct,N_correct) must be strictly positive.
smallest_decisive_gate.distance_transfer: At least two frozen distance buckets have D_correct - max(S_correct,R_correct,N_correct) strictly positive.
smallest_decisive_gate.promotion: Both scans consume all 587,138,826 bytes and match exactly; D has at least 254,953 active bytes; chronological and distance transfer pass; causal and resource bounds pass.
smallest_decisive_gate.next_gate: Trace exact retained-parent post-head surprisal only at the frozen D opportunity manifest, then require a native finite-coder P/K/D archive before any compression claim.
smallest_decisive_gate.retirement: Retire v2 if its envelope, any per-third or bucket matched-control margin, causality, repeat, or resource predicate fails; do not change key, hash, table, replacement, continuation, or controls in a rescue.
